Papa John's International is a publicly traded company, so there is no single majority owner; ownership is distributed among institutional investors and individuals [d1, d2]. The largest individual shareholder is founder John H. Schnatter, who owned 17.83% of the company as of the data cited [d5]. Major institutional shareholders include BlackRock Advisors LLC (15.37%) and Vanguard Fiduciary Trust Co. (11.79%) [d4]. Separately, the largest franchisee operator is Bajco Group (Nadeem Bajwa), which owns over 200 Papa John's restaurants but does not own equity in the parent company [d6, d8].
